+import csv
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import duckdb
+
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+DATA = ROOT / "data" / "crashes.parquet"
+OUT = ROOT / "out"
+
+con = duckdb.connect()
+con.execute("CREATE VIEW crashes AS SELECT crash_date, crash_time, number_of_persons_injured, number_of_persons_killed FROM read_parquet(?)", [str(DATA)])
+
+total_rows = con.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM crashes").fetchone()[0]
+date_stats = con.execute(
+    """SELECT min(crash_date), max(crash_date), count(*) FILTER (WHERE crash_date IS NULL)
+       FROM crashes"""
+).fetchone()
+date_min, date_max, missing_date = date_stats
+
+facts = []
+
+
+def add(fact, value):
+    facts.append((fact, value))
+
+
+def save_check(check_id):
+    with (OUT / f"check_{check_id}.csv").open("w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f:
+        writer = csv.writer(f)
+        writer.writerow(["fact", "value"])
+        writer.writerows(facts)
+
+
+for check_id in (1, 2):
+    facts.clear()
+    add("all crash rows in file", total_rows)
+    add("rows with missing crash_date (cannot assign year)", missing_date)
+    add("rows with missing crash_time", con.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM crashes WHERE crash_time IS NULL").fetchone()[0])
+    add("earliest nonmissing crash_date", date_min)
+    add("latest nonmissing crash_date", date_max)
+
+    candidate = "crash_date IS NOT NULL AND crash_time IS NOT NULL"
+    usable = candidate + " AND number_of_persons_injured IS NOT NULL AND number_of_persons_killed IS NOT NULL"
+    add("rows with date and time available (pre-outcome checks)", con.execute(f"SELECT count(*) FROM crashes WHERE {candidate}").fetchone()[0])
+    add("rows with valid date, time, and both outcome counts (candidate final population)", con.execute(f"SELECT count(*) FROM crashes WHERE {usable}").fetchone()[0])
+
+    for col in ("number_of_persons_injured", "number_of_persons_killed"):
+        add(f"{col}: missing among rows with valid date and time", con.execute(f"SELECT count(*) FROM crashes WHERE {candidate} AND {col} IS NULL").fetchone()[0])
+        add(f"{col}: negative/impossible among rows with valid date and time", con.execute(f"SELECT count(*) FROM crashes WHERE {candidate} AND {col} < 0").fetchone()[0])
+        add(f"{col}: zero among rows with valid date and time (valid zero, not treated as missing)", con.execute(f"SELECT count(*) FROM crashes WHERE {candidate} AND {col} = 0").fetchone()[0])
+
+    add("crash_time: exact-midnight rows among date-valid rows (valid hour; check for pileup)", con.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM crashes WHERE crash_date IS NOT NULL AND crash_time = TIME '00:00:00'").fetchone()[0])
+    years = con.execute(
+        f"""SELECT year(crash_date) AS yr,
+                   min(crash_date), max(crash_date),
+                   count(*) FILTER (WHERE {candidate}) AS rows_with_date_and_time,
+                   count(*) FILTER (WHERE {usable}) AS usable_rows,
+                   count(*) FILTER (WHERE crash_time IS NULL) AS missing_time_rows
+            FROM crashes WHERE crash_date IS NOT NULL
+            GROUP BY yr ORDER BY yr"""
+    ).fetchall()
+    add("per-year counts: year | first date | last date | date+time rows | final usable rows | missing-time rows", "")
+    for yr, first, last, candidate_n, usable_n, missing_time_n in years:
+        add(f"year {yr}: first/last date; date+time rows; final usable rows; missing-time rows", f"{first} | {last} | {candidate_n} | {usable_n} | {missing_time_n}")
+    if date_min is not None and date_max is not None:
+        add("boundary-year coverage", f"first year begins on {date_min}; last year ends on {date_max}; any boundary year not spanning Jan 1 through Dec 31 is partial")
+    save_check(check_id)
+
+con.close()
